title: Possible influence operation around news-voice.example (planted-flaw demo)

r1.text: Domain news-voice.example registered 2026-09-02 via registrar NameCo. Registrant privacy enabled.

r2.text: Channel @newsvoice posted 14 comments between 03:00 and 03:04 UTC on 2026-09-11, all containing the link news-voice.example/a1.

r3.text: Accounts u771, u772 and u773 each replied under three channels within one minute of each other, using identical wording.

r4.text: news-voice.example/a1 redirects to a page that republishes material from a known state outlet.
